B1.name: Ice Manipulation
B1.description: Kaden unleashes a valley of ice that encircles and traps opponents, dealing [Water] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Hurls ice chunks at nearby opponents, dealing small AoE damage equal to % of attack as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Summons spikes of ice to emerge from the ground around opponents, dealing AoE damage equal to % of attack and remaining on-field for a short time. Inflicts the [Freeze] debuff on hit opponents.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Explodes the ice spikes, dealing % of attack as AoE empowered damage.

additional.text: {{effect:freeze}}

S1.name: Ice Pillars
S1.description: Kaden creates a circle of four pillars of ice around him that shoot from the ground, dealing % of attack as [Water] damage.

additional.text: Holding the skill will summon one pillar at a time that can be aimed towards a specific direction. The skill has four charges and all are consumed to summon remaining pillars when skill is tapped.

Summoned pillars remain active for 15 seconds and act as destructible barriers. They remain in resonance with each other, dealing % of attack as [Water] damage which is multiplied by the number of pillars present, up to 4.
When destroyed by any character or opponent, they explode for AoE [Water] empowered damage equal to % of attack and inflict [Blind] and [Freeze] on anyone who is not Kaden himself.
{{effect:blind}}
{{effect:freeze}}
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Mana Cost: 120 MP (30 MP per pillar)

S2.name: Arsenal of Ice
S2.description: Kaden will create various objects of ice to aid in his battle. Hold down skill to rotate between a list of items; then letting go will select the specified item.

additional.text: Special Skill: Ice Beam - A directable beam, with a medium range, that does continuous damage equal to % of attack as [Water] damage per half-second for 4 seconds.
Special Skill: Ice Mass - Kaden hurls a single boulder of ice that hits an opponent, dealing % of attack as [Water] empowered damage.

Special Skill: Javelins’ Dance - Kaden summons a ring of (scales by level, rounded up) javelins around him that he hurls to opponents, dealing AoE [Water] damage equal to 160% of attack per javelin. When he is off-field, the javelins will be thrusted in 1 second intervals until no javelins are left.
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Mana Cost: 120 MP

S3.name: Cubic Trinity
S3.description: Kaden summons three cubes that swirl around him, lasting a brief time, and will implode upon contact with an opponent, dealing 350% of attack as AoE [Water] empowered damage. The cubes can remain even when Kaden is off-field.

additional.text: For each cube imploded, he will gain a stack, up to three stacks, of the buff [Ice Prince]. After each cube implodes, they remain for 10 seconds on-field, dealing 180% of attack as AoE [Water] damage per second.
{{effect:ice-prince}}
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Mana Cost: 110 MP

U1.name: Limitless Ice Beam
U1.description: Kaden charges up a stronger ice beam, gaining high range, that he blasts in two directions from his hands, dealing continuous [Water] damage per half-second equal to 240% of attack for 7 seconds.

additional.text: Hit opponents will gain the [Freeze] debuff and any subsequent hits during this state will increase their damage taken by +100%. The hit opponents will also gain debuff immunity reduction of -30% for the duration of skill.
{{effect:freeze}}
Energy Gauge: 100%

U2.name: Absolute Zero
U2.description: Mustering the very limits of his ice magic, Kaden unleashes a storm of ice particles and erupts a large ice spike from the ground, dealing 870% of attack as [Water] AoE damage.

additional.text: An ice rink will form after the attack that will continuously apply [Freeze] to opponents when they are hit with [Water] element attacks from any source, lasting 16 seconds.
During the effect, all other elements in the party will decrease in effectiveness by -100%. [Water] damage will, however, increase by +70%.
{{effect:freeze}}
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Ice Travel
T1.description: Kaden will phase through the shadow realm with the creation of two ice portals. This mechanic works by synchronizing two portals, each placed separately by using this skill a total of two times. Portals will remain indefinitely while in a combat session. Use skill again after placing two portals to reset and remove them.

additional.text: The two portals will allow any character to travel between them rapidly. Upon a successful warp, the character gains the buff [Shadow Miasma]. Standing within the portal after warping will maintain the effect.
If Kaden gains the effect, his Special Skill attacks will also do [Dark] damage during its duration.
{{effect:shadow-miasma}}
Energy Gauge: 8% per portal
Resonance: Other [Dark] affinity characters in team who are Icelorian or Gostlynger can utilize this ability.

Dupes.description: Kaden will gain a [Shield] equal to 350% of his defense whenever his health reaches at or below 50% (Cooldown: 30 seconds). He will also accumulate stacks of [Flash] upon successful basic skill attack hits with a cooldown of 1 second.

additional.text: He gains resonance within a party of more than 3 different affinities (dual affinity characters count both). Resonance will improve his and the team’s damage reduction by +20% and each hit from an opponent has a 50% chance to remove a debuff on the active character who is hit.

<u>Ice Fowler</u>: While not in combat, Kaden, when dashing, will create a trail of ice behind him as he surfs on an ice field. This state increases his movement speed by +40% and reduces stamina consumption by -50%. His movement across water is not reduced.
The secrets of District 1 are revealed when he is present. As a genius, puzzles will reveal a hint as the prodigy sees solutions effortlessly.
<u>Alter Exclusive Rule</u>: Ion Mustard (Alter)’s Star Levels (except base) are deactivated while as Kaden Icelander.
{{effect:shield}}
{{effect:flash}}
The [Freeze] effect can be stacked for the duration of attacks that add it. For each stack, Kaden’s damage will increase by +5%.
{{effect:freeze}}
The [Flash] effect can be applied to allies also but at half the speed, along with gaining continuous stacks of [Fatigue] on self for every stack gained on self.
The Technical Skill: Ice Travel will apply effect even if Kaden stands within 10 meters of any portal. The range of [Shadow Miasma] will also increase by +100%.
{{effect:fatigue}}
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.
Kaden will gain an awakened state upon reaching 30 stacks of [Fatigue] in which his eye reveals a special power, gaining the buff [Icengon].
{{effect:icengon}}

Whenever this character gains [Fatigue], gain 1% of health as mana for self and heal allies for that percentage of health. Deal an additional +5% more damage on opponents for each stack of [Freeze] applied.
The gaining of [Flash] will now be as fast as each basic skill stage, therefore increasing the rate of accumulation without a cooldown.
